turns.agent:
I couldn't make the flyer. Your Magic Hour account doesn't have enough credits. I tried twice: first with qwen-image-2.1 (about 10 credits), then with z-image-turbo, one of the cheapest free-plan models (about 5 credits). Both were turned down for low credits, so nothing was made and no credits were used.

**What you can do:**
- **Top up or wait for your credits to refresh**, then tell me and I'll run it again. A 640px flyer on a free-plan model costs about 5–10 credits.
- **Send me the event details**, if you like, so the next try is ready to print: the studio name, date, time, address, and website or Instagram. Some of this may need adding in Canva or similar, because free models often get small text wrong.

**Here's the design I'd use:**
- **Style:** Bold linocut / woodblock look on cream paper with visible grain, in deep indigo, red-orange and black ink.
- **Headline:** "PRINTMAKERS OPEN STUDIO" in chunky block letters that look hand-carved.
- **Picture:** An inked roller going over a carved lino block, an etching press wheel, and fresh prints pegged on a drying line.
- **Small text:** "Demos • Prints for Sale • Meet the Artists", plus your date, time and place.
- **Size:** Portrait, 9:16.
